tokens.name: c-surface
tokens.usage: Page ground (the body, the header). ink 13.1:1, ink-muted 5.8:1, accent-strong as a link 7.8:1 on it.

tokens.name: c-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the footer, the photo placeholder's circle, the logo's pin. ink 14.0:1, ink-muted 6.2:1, accent-strong 8.3:1 on it.

tokens.name: c-surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating bands and the mail ground. ink 12.1:1, ink-muted 5.4:1, accent-strong 7.2:1 on it.

tokens.name: c-ink
tokens.usage: All body text and headings, on surface, surface-raised, surface-alt, accent-soft (11.5:1) and placeholder-ground (10.7:1). The wordmark's name.

tokens.name: c-ink-strong
tokens.usage: Strongest text; the source of the focus colour.

tokens.name: c-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, help text, placeholders, the '(optional)' hint. On surface 5.8:1, surface-raised 6.2:1, surface-alt 5.4:1, accent-soft 5.1:1. On overlay-circle 4.9:1 but the site uses it there only from 24 px.

tokens.name: c-accent
tokens.usage: The vermilion accent: the logo's spark, the home category icons, the canton hover, the 32 px bar under the mail logo. Never behind text, never text below 24 px. As an icon: 3.7 / 3.9 / 3.4:1 on surface / raised / alt (needs 3).

tokens.name: c-accent-strong
tokens.usage: The indigo primary: primary buttons, links, selected edges, icons, the logo's badge and '.ch'. The only saturated ground behind text (on-accent on it 8.3:1). As text: 7.8 / 8.3 / 7.2:1 on surface / raised / alt, 6.9:1 on accent-soft.

tokens.name: c-accent-strong-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of a primary button; ink and edge of a hovered secondary button and chip. White on it 10.8:1.

tokens.name: c-accent-strong-active
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button. White on it 13.2:1.

tokens.name: c-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected ground: active chip, pressed Merken button, hover of ghost/round/secondary buttons. Only c-ink (11.5:1) or accent-strong (6.9:1) on it.

tokens.name: c-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent-strong fill (primary button, count badge).

tokens.name: c-line
tokens.usage: = ink. The 1 px underline of a text field.

tokens.name: c-line-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative 1 px lines and the neutral chip's edge. Carries no information (1.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: c-focus
tokens.usage: = ink-strong. The 2 px focus ring (--focus-ring: 2px solid), offset 2 px.

tokens.name: c-error
tokens.usage: Error text and the invalid field's 2 px underline. On surface-raised 6.5:1, on error-soft 5.6:1. Always with words and an icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: c-error-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the form's error summary; only c-error on it.

tokens.name: c-success
tokens.usage: Success icon and text (inquiry sent). On success-soft 5.4:1, on surface-raised 6.2:1.

tokens.name: c-success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the success disc after an inquiry.

tokens.name: c-disabled-ground
tokens.usage: Disabled button, chip and field ground. Inactive states never use opacity.

tokens.name: c-disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Text on disabled-ground (5.1:1).

tokens.name: c-tier-ground
tokens.usage: = accent-soft. The tier badge on a card (Pro); ink on it.

tokens.name: c-tag-ground
tokens.usage: = surface-alt. Price level and ambience tags; ink on it.

tokens.name: c-overlay-ground
tokens.usage: = surface-alt. Ground of the phone menu and dialogs.

tokens.name: c-overlay-circle
tokens.usage: The soft circles of the overlays. ink-muted on it only from 24 px; links in accent-strong-hover (8.4:1).

tokens.name: c-placeholder-ground
tokens.usage: Behind a photo while it loads, and the photo placeholder's ground. accent-strong icon on it 6.4:1.

tokens.name: c-map-land
tokens.usage: = surface-raised. Cantons on the Swiss map.

tokens.name: c-map-line
tokens.usage: Canton borders on the map.

tokens.name: c-map-hover
tokens.usage: = accent. A hovered canton.

tokens.name: c-map-selected
tokens.usage: A selected canton.

tokens.name: c-map-lake
tokens.usage: Lakes on the map.

tokens.name: c-map-radius
tokens.usage: accent-strong at 20 %: the search radius circle on the region map.

tokens.name: mail-dark-ground
tokens.usage: Mail dark mode only (prefers-color-scheme: dark in the mail layout): the outer ground. A mail cannot read CSS variables, so these stay literals.

tokens.name: mail-dark-card
tokens.usage: Mail dark mode: the card. mail-dark-text 12.7:1, mail-dark-muted 8.7:1, mail-dark-link 9.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: mail-dark-heading
tokens.usage: Mail dark mode: headings on mail-dark-card (14.9:1).

tokens.name: mail-dark-text
tokens.usage: Mail dark mode: body text on mail-dark-card.

tokens.name: mail-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Mail dark mode: the footer and muted text.

tokens.name: mail-dark-link
tokens.usage: Mail dark mode: links. A light tint of the primary; it follows accent-strong when the brand changes.

tokens.name: mail-dark-rule
tokens.usage: Mail dark mode: the rule between blocks.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: --fs-display / --lh-display: the home page hero below 768 px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: --fs-h2: section titles and the venue card title below 768 px.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: --fs-number: the step numbers of the home page, 36/44 at every width.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: --fs-body, line-height 26 px (unitless 1.625 so it inherits). Running text and field values.
styles.sample: Frag direkt bei der Location an. Kostenlos und unverbindlich.

styles.name: body-semibold
styles.usage: Emphasis in running text; the current nav item.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: --fs-small: card summary, facts line, help and error text, the privacy line.
styles.sample: Deine Angaben gehen direkt an die Location.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, the Merken button, form promises.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: --fs-button: medium buttons. Chips use the same size at 600.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: --fs-tag: tier badge, tags, the label under a round button.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: between facts lines, the count badge's side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons and chips; label to field; card body gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Merken button side padding; chip padding beside the ×.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between card photo and body (vertical).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Button side padding (md); form row gap; header side padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Large button side padding; header action gap from lg.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Dialog and filter-panel padding, footer gaps, the phone menu's bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Footer top padding from md, filter-panel top padding, wide column gaps.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Small floating surfaces and their rows: the region filter's suggestion list, the map tooltip, the items of the detail page's share menu.

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: Photos, the photo placeholder in a card, the error summary.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Venue cards and detail sections (the inquiry form card).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, tags, the Merken button, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers only (dropdowns, toasts). Cards have no shadow.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header height below 768 px; 5.75rem from md.
